{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

commas_in_revenue = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of rows with commas in revenue: {commas_in_revenue.sum()}')

# Display first few revenue strings
print('\nFirst few revenue strings:')
print(df['revenue'].head())"}
